description: Known answers for StateDelta composition (04 §5.1-§5.4), the commit boundary (04 §5.1, 03 §15) and the r3_pr5 invariant checks. Expected values are hand-written. States: facts and fact_defaults are row lists here; the test harness indexes them by canonical text (lib/loka/core/compose.ex). Three boundary cases are too long to list here; every host must build and run them (both kernels do: test/loka/core/compose_test.exs, kernel/ts/test/compose.test.ts). In them, id <pp>…<n> is "<pp>000000-0000-4000-8000-" followed by n zero-padded to 12 digits, every op has writer_group 0, and every job is lantern 0.1.0 schedule bram. (1) budget-before-first-op-fault: state base; job.schedule d1…0 due 30 (a job that already exists), then job.schedule f2…1 to f2…64 due 100; expected fault budget_exceeded, not precondition_failed. (2) pending-jobs-bound-is-the-final-queue: state clock 6 and jobs f0…1 to f0…1024, each pending with due_time 3; job.schedule f1…0 due 20, then job.complete f0…1; expected changes: job f0…1 completed with due_time 3, then job f1…0 pending with due_time 20. (3) changes-sorted-by-target-over-32-rows: state clock 0 and containers e0…1 to e0…40, all in 10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000; entity.transfer of each from there to 20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000, in the order e0…40 down to e0…1; expected 40 containment rows, e0…1 to e0…40 ascending, each with value 20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000.
